content: जीवत् {%a.%} (-न्ती|{%f.%}) Living, alive.  .{@-तोका@} a woman whose children are living. .{@-पतिः@} {%f.%} {@-पत्नी@} {%f.%} a woman whose husband is living. .{@-पितृकः@} one whose father is alive. .{@-मुक्त@} {%a.%} ‘liberated while living’, a man who, being purified by a true knowledge of the Supreme Spirit, is freed from the future birth and all ceremonial rites while yet living. .{@-मुक्तिः@} {%f.%} final liberation in the present state of life. .{@-मृत@} {%a.%} ‘dead while alive’, one who, though alive, is as good as dead and useless to the world (said of a mad man or one whose character is lost).
